## 更新内容
- 修复展开候选「词频」漏掉最前面几个词的问题
- 修复用户词标记「*」把格子撑宽的问题
- 修复展开候选左侧栏半透明的问题
- 修复有时没切换英文键盘，打开却是英文的问题
- 新增卡顿诊断：在 设置 → 虚拟键盘 → 卡顿诊断 打开后可导出 txt 日志，默认关闭

## Changes
- Fixed the expanded Frequency list skipping the first words
- Fixed the user-dict * mark making a candidate cell wider
- Fixed the expanded candidates left rail being translucent
- Fixed the keyboard sometimes opening in English by mistake
- Added lag diagnostics under Settings → Virtual Keyboard → Lag diagnostics, with a one-tap export to txt (off by default)
